rationale: Inspection of the attached authoritative page supports the translated equation's scalar types, coefficient, differential operators, and singleton reduction. The translated proposition nevertheless asserts only a representation equivalence, whereas the selected passage also asserts equation satisfaction for the transported concentration and real-scalar hyperbolicity. It is therefore weaker than the selected source claim. Adjudication is requested for the unresolved solution concept and any proposed narrowing of the selected result to scalar reduction alone.
